title: OK bowls, but surprisingly flimsy ...
text:
OK bowls, but surprisingly flimsy .... Nice size, but not as sturdy as they appear in the photos. The plastic is decent quality and crystal clear, but the "walls" are quite thin with a little too much "give" for comfort -- I worry about breakage with normal use (i.e., picking up the bowl when it actually has something in it). I would definitely hesitate to put anything heavier than a salad or some dinner rolls in them.

They are dishwasher safe, but I hand washed and dried mine the two times I've used them so far. Not sure I can recommend them at the current list (just under fifteen dollars). I think there are better options available that would be more economical. So -- they're OK -- 3 stars.​
